title: Git HTTP Server (Alpine)
description: A lightweight Git-over-http server that allows git requests to a specified local repository folder.

env.name: CONTAINER_NAME
env.label: Container name
env.description: Container name (for docker, unlike 'Name' above which is only used by Portainer to manage displayed stacks)

env.name: PORT
env.label: Port
env.description: Port to use for the php server (check that it is not in use)

env.name: REPO_ROOT
env.label: Repository folder
env.description: Path on host to use for the Git repository to serve. For Windows, enclose in quotes and escape path separators with double-backslashes.

env.name: RESTART
env.label: Restart
env.description: Restart behavior (on failure or Docker engine restart)
